meta.name: add-linear
meta.description: Add Linear channel integration via Chat SDK. Issue comment threads as conversations.

copy.tagline: 把 Linear 问题评论同步成聊天对话
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想把 Linear 的讨论直接搬到聊天里。
copy.tagline_en: Sync Linear issue comments into chat conversations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want Linear discussions to land directly in chat.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会监听你指定的 Linear 团队:该团队 issue 上的每条评论都会触发它回复,按 issue 分成独立对话,无需 @提及。它还会根据教程完成代码改动、登记和连接配置。
howto.when: 当你说要接入 Linear 时开始执行:复制适配器、收集凭据、接线;接通后,配置团队里每个 issue 的每条新评论都会触发回复,无需 @提及。

say.text: 请给 NanoClaw 加上 Linear 频道,监听 ENG 团队的评论。
say.note: 会先复制适配器并登记,再收集凭据和接线。

say.text: 接 Linear 时用 OAuth 应用身份,不要用我个人 API key。
say.note: 会按 OAuth 方式填写客户端凭据。

say.text: 把 Linear 的发送策略设为 strict,并按 issue 线程隔离会话。
say.note: 会写入对应接线参数并重启服务。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude watches the Linear team you configured: every comment on an issue in that team triggers a reply, each issue thread becomes its own conversation, and no @-mention is needed. It also carries out the code changes, registration, and connection steps from the guide.
howto.when_en: It starts when you ask to integrate Linear: copying the adapter, collecting credentials, and wiring. Once connected, every new comment on an issue in the configured team triggers a reply—no @-mention required.

say_en.text: Please add the Linear channel to NanoClaw and watch comments for the ENG team.
say_en.note: It copies the adapter, registers it, then collects credentials and wires it.

say_en.text: When integrating Linear, use the OAuth app identity, not my personal API key.
say_en.note: It configures client credentials via OAuth.

say_en.text: Set the Linear sender policy to strict and isolate sessions per issue thread.
say_en.note: It writes the wiring parameters and restarts the service.
